title: k11 Release Gate MCP Server
description:
MCP server and CI gate that turns UI, API contract, API functional, LLM red-team and JUnit evidence into one deterministic release decision under a written policy (ship, ship with conditions, needs a named person, or block), with diff-aware planning and an audit record that links every reason to its evidence file and SHA-256.

Source code: https://github.com/K11-Software-Solutions/k11techlab-release-gate-mcp
